# BRIEF - film_siach: morning talk 26/10/2026 (Mechina Beit HaTalmud) - a 3D film for the builders

Source: the real morning talk in the beit midrash (recorded audio). The REAL VOICE of the speaker plays under the whole film (5 clips, 235.75 s in total, kept in the day folder, mixed locally later - do NOT add any audio to the page). The picture must act out what is said; captions summarise it (Hebrew, ids only for builders).
Audience: Haredi boys, mechina age 13-17. Shown with the real talk audio + soft music.
Central idea: hospitality (welcoming people) when it is NOT comfortable. A man drives a brand-new clean electric car on a rainy day, warm and cosy inside; near the city he sees a Jew walking alone in the pouring rain, soaked, heavy bags, splashed by passing cars - take him and get the new car muddy, or not? He stops and takes him. The same test at home: tired after a long day, you want five minutes of quiet, and a little boy needs help. Avraham (this week's parasha, Vayera) on the third day after the brit, on a burning hot day, still looked for guests and washed their dusty feet. And on a bus: someone gets on looking for a seat - move your bag and give him a warm face; giving someone a good feeling is possible every moment.
